title: SEO Metadata Spec Compiler
description: Compiles the SEO metadata specification for all content types. Enforces: every type has a title template, title length within 50–60 characters, meta description within 120–155 characters, OG image dimensions declared, robots directive set, and hreflang coverage for all localized content types.

error_codes.SMS001: seo-metadata-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: content_types[] with title_template, meta_description_template
error_codes.SMS002: Content type missing SEO title template — every content type must have a title tag template
error_codes.SMS003: Title template produces output outside 50–60 character range — validate with representative content
error_codes.SMS004: Meta description template produces output outside 120–155 character range — adjust template length
error_codes.SMS005: OG image dimensions not declared or below 1200×630px minimum — declare og_image dimensions per content type
error_codes.SMS006: Robots directive not declared for content type — specify index/noindex and follow/nofollow per type
error_codes.SMS007: hreflang rules do not cover all declared locales for a localized content type
